source_refs.note: Exercise 2.1, Question 13 (i)-(ii): dy/dx for parametric equations; book p. 41. Unit 2 has no printed answers.

blocks.prompt: 13 (i) Find \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) for the following parametric equations: \(x = \sin^2 t\) and \(y = \cos 2t\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh parametric equations ka sawal hai: \(x\) aur \(y\) dono ek teesre variable \(t\) (parameter) ke zariye diye gaye hain.
Diya kya hai? \(x = \sin^2 t\), \(y = \cos 2t\). Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Rule kaunsa? Section 2.3.2 ka formula \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\). Is ka matlab: \(y\) kitni tezi se badal raha hai, \(x\) ke muqable mein.
Plan: dono ko \(t\) ke respect se differentiate karenge, phir divide karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x = \sin^2 t\), \(y = \cos 2t\).
Maloom karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\), shart yeh ke \(\frac{dx}{dt} \neq 0\). \(t\) ko khatam karne ki zaroorat nahi, seedha dono derivatives le lete hain.

\(x\) ka derivative \(t\) ke respect se
\[\dfrac{dx}{dt} = 2\sin t\cos t = \sin 2t\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 t = (\sin t)^2\) par chain rule: \(2\sin t\) darja \(\cos t\). Phir double angle formula \(2\sin t\cos t = \sin 2t\).

\(y\) ka derivative \(t\) ke respect se
\[\dfrac{dy}{dt} = -\sin 2t \cdot 2 = -2\sin 2t\]
Kyun: \(\cos(2t)\) par chain rule: \(-\sin 2t\) darja andar ka derivative 2.
Dhyan dein: andar wala 2 bhoolna aam ghalti hai; us ke baghair jawab \(-1\) aa jata, jo ghalat hai.

Divide karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{-2\sin 2t}{\sin 2t} = -2\]
Kyun: parametric formula. \(\sin 2t\) upar neeche cancel ho gaya; yeh wahan jaiz hai jahan \(\sin 2t \neq 0\).

Tasdeeq: \(t\) ko khatam kar ke
\[\cos 2t = 1 - 2\sin^2 t\]
\[y = 1 - 2x\]
Kyun: double angle formula se \(y\) seedha \(x\) mein likha ja sakta hai. Yeh ek seedhi line hai jis ka slope \(-2\) hai, bilkul hamare jawab jaisa. Isi liye jawab mein \(t\) nahi aaya: line ka slope har jagah ek hi hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 13 (ii) Find \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) for the following parametric equations: \(x = \sqrt{1 + \sec t}\), and \(y = \sqrt{\tan t}\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir parametric sawal, lekin is dafa dono equations mein square root hai, is liye \(t\) ke respect se derivative lete waqt chain rule bhi lagega.
Diya kya hai? \(x = \sqrt{1 + \sec t}\), \(y = \sqrt{\tan t}\). Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Rule kaunsa? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\), aur root ke liye \(\frac{d}{dt}\sqrt{w} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{w}}\cdot\frac{dw}{dt}\).
Plan: dono derivatives nikalenge, divide karenge, phir \(\frac{\sec t}{\tan t} = \csc t\) se jawab ko chhota karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x = \sqrt{1 + \sec t}\), \(y = \sqrt{\tan t}\), jahan \(0 < t < \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Maloom karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: parametric formula. \(0 < t < \frac{\pi}{2}\) isliye ke \(\sqrt{\tan t}\) ke liye \(\tan t > 0\) aur \(\sqrt{1 + \sec t}\) ke liye \(1 + \sec t \geq 0\) chahiye; dono saath sirf pehle quadrant mein milte hain.

\(\frac{dx}{dt}\) nikalein
\[\dfrac{dx}{dt} = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{1 + \sec t}} \cdot \sec t\tan t\]
Kyun: root ke andar \(w = 1 + \sec t\) hai. Root ka derivative \(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{w}}\), darja andar ka derivative \((1 + \sec t)' = \sec t\tan t\).

\(\frac{dy}{dt}\) nikalein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dt} = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{\tan t}} \cdot \sec^2 t\]
Kyun: andar \(w = \tan t\), aur \((\tan t)' = \sec^2 t\).

Divide karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sec^2 t}{2\sqrt{\tan t}} \cdot \dfrac{2\sqrt{1 + \sec t}}{\sec t\tan t}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sec t\sqrt{1 + \sec t}}{\tan t\sqrt{\tan t}}\]
Kyun: fraction se divide karna yani us ke ulte se multiply karna. 2 aur 2 cancel, \(\sec^2 t\) mein se ek \(\sec t\) cancel.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\) mein \(dy/dt\) upar jata hai. Ulta likhne se \(\frac{dx}{dy}\) mil jayega, jo poocha hi nahi.

Aur saaf shakal
\[\dfrac{\sec t}{\tan t} = \csc t,\quad \dfrac{1 + \sec t}{\tan t} = \dfrac{1 + \cos t}{\sin t}\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \csc t\sqrt{\dfrac{1 + \cos t}{\sin t}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\sec t}{\tan t} = \frac{1}{\cos t}\cdot\frac{\cos t}{\sin t} = \frac{1}{\sin t}\). Do roots ko ek root mein jor sakte hain kyunke yahan dono positive hain. Phir \(\frac{1 + \sec t}{\tan t}\) ke upar neeche \(\cos t\) se multiply kiya to \(\frac{\cos t + 1}{\sin t}\) bana. Dono shaklein sahi hain.

Tasdeeq \(t = \frac{\pi}{4}\) par
\[\sqrt{2}\sqrt{\dfrac{1 + 0.7071}{0.7071}} \approx 2.197\]
Kyun: pehli shakal mein bhi yahi number aata hai, aur sympy se numerically check karne par bhi yahi value mili.
blocks.final_answer: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\sec t\sqrt{1 + \sec t}}{\tan t\sqrt{\tan t}} = \csc t\sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos t}{\sin t}}\)
